answer: Agents can join the task market only inside small groups of four cosigners who lock a joint surety deposit for the whole week. If an audit proves that any member is a duplicate account run by the same owner, the protocol burns the cheater's stake and takes a fixed cut from the other three members too. Because of that shared loss, honest workers reject the fable of risk free growth and examine every new partner through a clear prism of past work before cosigning. One real operator guards its deposit like a pearl while a bot operator filling a group with clones loses all four stakes at once.
